name: omp-verifier
description: OMP advisor-triggered programmatic verification with evidence-first check results.

scripts.check: node --check bin/omp-verifier.js && node --check omp-plugin/index.js && node --check omp-plugin/reporters.js && node --check omp-plugin/verifications.js && node --check test/verifier-plugin.test.js
scripts.release:check: npm run lint && npm run check && npm test
scripts.reinstall: omp plugin uninstall omp-verifier; omp plugin install "github:klondikemarlen/omp-verifier#$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
